items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Ever know a guy named Joshua Altheimer over there? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, I've heard of him. I don't know of him.

ctx.x: Oh. From a good ways off. That's right. Ever know a guy named Joshua Altheimer over there? Played piano. Used to play with Washboard Sam a lot.
Oh, I've heard of him. I don't know of him.
